requirements.title: The UI shall guide complete saved-shot creation.
requirements.description: The shot builder shall let a user choose device/scene, assign media, configure presentation/motion/output, preview, render/export and reopen a saved project with persistent preview and actionable states.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-EDIT-GUIDED protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The editor shall expose advanced shot controls.
requirements.description: The editor shall expose camera and focal framing, lighting, support/placement, screen calibration, device/joint keyframes and timeline timing while preserving qualified limits and independent reusable libraries.

requirements.description: The UI shall provide framing/pose preview and asynchronous final-profile checkpoints with labeled fidelity, progress, cancellation and measured latency rather than claiming native-render interactive speed.

requirements.description: The UI shall provide visible labels, keyboard/numeric alternatives to drag controls, focus recovery, noncolor status cues and responsive review of the core workflow.
